objects.name: Analytic 2152
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies system binaries (bash, python, perl, awk, dd) on Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux assets executing with arguments that pipe or decode external content rather than performing their documented administrative function. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): system binary executing with command line piping or decoding external content, from Industrial Control Systems (ICS) service account User Identifier (UID)

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Inventory of ICS hosts warranting this elevated monitoring.
Documented command-line argument patterns for living-off-the-land binary abuse.
